annotation.bound_parties_text: The part binds executive agencies using Government aircraft (including SAMOs), with GSA also having stated responsibilities; the Armed Forces are largely excluded.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This part applies to all federally funded aviation activities using Government aircraft for official executive branch business.
annotation.dates_quote: Source: 90 FR 58425, Dec. 16, 2025, unless otherwise noted.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: means remotely or autonomously flown aircraft and required components.
